[attribute-fn-type]
=== `@fn-type` Type of Footnote

Type of information conveyed in the footnote (for example, financial disclosure).

#### Usage/Remarks
There are many reasons why the text or metadata of a standard might be footnoted. Where those reasons are known, this attribute can preserve that information. This could be a means of preserving, for example, that a member of the original Working Group or Committee is now deceased.
Since the use of `@fn-type` in standards documents is currently uncommon, there is no list of suggested values, and standards organizations are free to use any value for this attribute.

#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-fn,`<fn>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| Letter, numbers, of special characters| The reason for the footnote or type of footnote, such as 
                        “`Conflict of interest`”, 
                        “`deceased`”, or  
                        “`financial-disclosure`”.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
